messages:
alex-eng: Customer reports SSE stream truncates ~20-30s after idle when routed through Cloudflare -> ALB -> nginx. Direct to origin works. Partial chunk then socket reset. Seen in Chrome and curl.

maria-support: Can you paste repro steps + the exact request chain? is it client -> CF -> ALB -> nginx -> app?

alex-eng: Yep. Repro: `curl -v -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=longstream` against their staging domain. App emits small data chunks and a single space heartbeat every 10s.

raj-support: Pasted app logs. App writes heartbeats: `write(" "); fflush(stdout);` Response headers: `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`.

alex-eng: From the proxy logs: 
```
upstream read error: connection reset by peer while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.0.5, server: _, request: "GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1"
```
We also see repeated `upstream prematurely closed connection` and a truncated chunk boundary in captured bytes.

maria-support: Two likely places: ALB idle timeout (default 60s) and proxy buffering (nginx/Cloudflare). nginx defaults to `proxy_buffering on` which will buffer small chunks until enough data or downstream pull. Also CF can reassemble/chunk.

alex-eng: Customer ALB was default 60s. They bumped ALB idle to 350s and issue reduced but not gone. With Cloudflare in front it still truncates. If we bypass CF -> stable.

raj-support: Attached tcpdump showing last bytes before reset. Chunked framing around loss point looks like: 
```
3e\r\n<...payload...>\r\n0\r\n\r\n
```
but the `\r\n` after a chunk sometimes missing in the capture after proxy.

maria-support: Suggested immediate nginx config to try on origin:
```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
proxy_read_timeout 360s;
```
Also advise ALB idle timeout >= 180-300s.

deploy-bot: Deployed `proxy_buffering off` to staging nginx (staging-232) at 2026-03-17T15:42:00Z.

alex-eng: Staging test w/ CF disabled -> stable. With CF still in front -> truncation persists. Looks like CF response buffering is interfering; CF standard plan doesn't expose full origin buffering controls.

maria-support: Short-term workaround: send SSE comments/heartbeats as full CRLF-delimited events (e.g., `: keepalive\n\n`) or small newline-only chunks every 10-15s so CDN sees activity. Also ensure no `Content-Length` and explicit `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`.

alex-eng: We recommended the customer change nginx + ALB as above and add application-side periodic comment events `: hb\n\n`. Provided sample client-side reconnection strategy too.

raj-support: Customer applied nginx changes and ALB idle 350s. They still need CF change but confirmed that adding `: hb\n\n` heartbeat fixed the symptom for now.

maria-support: Escalating for eng-runtime to look at whether our SSE implementation can emit slightly larger keepalives (and ensure proper chunk terminators) when a CDN is detected. @alex-eng please attach pcap and curl commands to the escalation.

sre-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0487 and assigned to eng-runtime.

alex-eng: Uploaded pcap + minimal repro curl command to the incident.

raj-support: Customer confirmed resolution after nginx + ALB changes plus application heartbeat. Asking to monitor for recurrence. Closing on our side but will reopen if it reappears. :thumbsup:
